title: Letter Road Driving
shareTitle: Letter Road Driving 🚗 — Letter Shapes on Wheels
description: Drive a cheerful little car along single- and multi-stroke roads shaped like uppercase letters, following each numbered start in order.
learningGoals: Explore letter shapes through movement and direction
Control one continuous stroke through straight and curved letter forms
Follow numbered starts to learn uppercase multi-stroke order
interactionModel: strand-proof finger tracing with a top-down car that turns along procedural letter roads
feedbackModel: Driven lanes glow gold, the car gives a soft toy honk, cloned teacher voice names the letter, and off-road movement gets a gentle spoken steering cue.

modes.title: Easy Roads
modes.skill: continuous control on single-stroke uppercase letter shapes
